summary: Learn to design and scale last-mile agritech solutions with practical product, data, finance, and partnership labs. Enquire about delivery options.
lede: Last-mile agritech training helps agribusiness and programme teams design and test digital services for smallholder farmers. Participants practise mapping farmer needs and value chains, shaping minimum viable products and business models, building data-collection plans, and setting adoption measures and partner roles for a measurable pilot. The course also introduces offline-first workflows, input-credit scoring, IoT traceability, and AI-assisted segmentation at a conceptual level.
audienceIntro: Last-mile agritech teams need a shared language across farmer research, product delivery, rural operations, data management, finance, and development reporting. This course is designed for professionals who must connect digital product decisions with field adoption and agribusiness results.
modules: Input Credit Scoring and Responsible Finance
prerequisites: You should have working experience in agricultural programmes, agribusiness operations, cooperative services, digital product delivery, rural finance, or field data collection. No coding or programming is required. You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and basic programme or operational metrics. Advanced AI-assisted scoring, IoT architecture, and interoperability topics receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than production engineering depth.
